strings.minik_swish_info_privacy_body:
About the questions:
Some questions, answers, and explanations were created or edited with AI assistance and then reviewed to the best of our ability. Errors may still occur. The content is not official material from a university, education authority, examination body, or employer, and should not replace an authoritative source when accuracy matters.

Privacy in the current version:
For game rooms and leaderboards, the app may store a player nickname, anonymous identifier, scores, streaks, and room state in Firebase. Raw motion-sensor readings are used to control the shot and are processed on-device; the current game code does not intentionally upload those raw readings to Firebase.

Before store release, publish a complete and current privacy policy that accurately matches every SDK and service used by the app.

strings.minik_swish_team_intro_how_to:
Move: swipe the court.
Pass: tap a teammate.
Shoot: hold empty court for about one second, then release. We aim at the basket; distance, the defender and your character's shooting ability determine the chance. A full meter helps but does not guarantee a basket. Drive close for a layup or dunk.
Alley-oop: double-tap a teammate.
Screen: hold a teammate.
Defense: move close and tap anywhere on the court. Tap a teammate to switch defender.
Shoot before the 24-second shot clock expires.
Change hands: swipe left-right-left. Repeat quickly for a behind-the-back crossover.
Spin: draw a small circle while dribbling. Quick repeats help, but a guard can still stay with you.
A teammate comes to screen a close guard. Move around the screen; do not try to walk through the defender.

strings.minik_swish_tutorial_aim_body: Tilt the phone slightly left or right, or drag left or right anywhere on the court. The marker near the hoop shows the shot direction.
strings.minik_swish_tutorial_choose_body: Tap the answer you think is correct. The player will automatically dribble to its shooting spot.
strings.minik_swish_tutorial_free_body: That’s it: answer → aim → arc/power → shoot. With touch, learn the power point through drag depth; with sensors, forward speed gives full manual control. The ? button opens the tutorial again.
strings.minik_swish_tutorial_pull_body: Tilt the phone slightly backward, or drag down or up on the court. With touch, drag distance controls both the arc and base power: too little tends to fall short; too much tends to be strong.
strings.minik_swish_tutorial_throw_body: With touch: when the aim and arc look right, simply release. A quick upward flick adds extra power, but it is optional. With device motion, forward speed still determines power.
